Class XmlEventType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.session.io.xml.v2_0.XmlEventType
public class XmlEventType extends Object
 <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><a xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml" xmlns:xs="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" href="https://talkbank.org/manuals/CHAT.html#SimpleEvents">CHAT manual section on
                     this topic...</a>

Java class for eventType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="eventType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <sequence>
         <choice>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}action"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}happening"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}otherSpokenEvent"/>
         </choice>
         <choice maxOccurs="unbounded" minOccurs="0">
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}k"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}error"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}overlap"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}ga"/>
           <element ref="{https://phon.ca/ns/session}duration"/>
         </choice>
       </sequence>
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>

    • getKOrErrorOrOverlap

      public List<Object> getKOrErrorOrOverlap()
      Gets the value of the kOrErrorOrOverlap property.

      This accessor method returns a reference to the live list, not a snapshot. Therefore any modification you make to the returned list will be present inside the Jakarta XML Binding object. This is why there is not a set method for the kOrErrorOrOverlap property.

      For example, to add a new item, do as follows: 

          getKOrErrorOrOverlap().add(newItem);

      Objects of the following type(s) are allowed in the list XmlMarkerType XmlErrorType XmlOverlapType XmlGroupAnnotationType XmlDurationType
